calls.body: At home, the Canucks keep sending Pettersson (#40)’s line (DeBrusk, Pettersson (#40) and Lekkerimäki) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Manny Malhotra has been choosing strength on strength. Tonight the Wild’s first line is Kaprizov, Ek and Boldy.

story.head: The Canucks end Wallstedt’s eight-game win streak
paras: Luke Schenn and Marcus Foligno squared off early in the first. Matt Boldy got the scoring started for the Wild midway through the second. Marco Rossi tied it up for Vancouver on the power play a little over four minutes later. Jared Spurgeon restored the Wild’s lead a little over a minute later, with Boldy picking up his 200th NHL assist on the goal. Zeev Buium tied it 2-2 for Vancouver just 30 seconds into the third, and Nick Foligno put the Wild back ahead 3-2 with just under two minutes left. With the goalie pulled and less than two minutes left, Rossi struck again to tie it 3-3. Jake DeBrusk scored the only goal of the shootout for the Canucks. Brock Boeser finished with three assists.

The Wild had a little more of the play, but the Canucks won the shootout. Leevi Meriläinen made 22 saves for the Canucks, and Jesper Wallstedt stopped 21 of 24 at the other end. The loss ended Wallstedt’s eight-game winning streak. The Canucks improved to 6-18-1, still last in the NHL, while the Wild dropped to 17-3-5, still first in the NHL in points.
